supersedes: Only the native Dynamax initial covariance M-step in the baseline declared by plan54_v1.json
reason: Native first M-step produces an indefinite initial covariance and NaN likelihood. Diagnosis and repair use training observations only, before heldout evaluation or state readout fitting.
qualification: Independent NumPy expected initial moments, positive corrected initial covariance, bitwise identical other M-step parameters, three increasing finite native EM objectives. Qualification uses training observations without latent labels.
prior_attempts: Two 200-iteration native seed0 attempts are preserved as failed; the second retained NaN history/candidate arrays before report serialization stopped. They are not selected or counted as successful fits.
runtime: Same existing CPU environment; EM workers use eight logical processors 24-31 and RP workers use 16-23. No global environment changes.
scientific_interpretation: Ordinary corrected LGSSM EM is the strong baseline. This is a routine implementation correction and is not a novel model, likelihood, or inference method.
